body: Refreshed with main (c8a1bab1): merged #1131's refreshed branch `issue/541-sinker-burn-depth` (f3b24dc6) first, then `upstream/main`. Head is now f36c1005. Only `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` conflicted, in both merges. I set it to 24: main is at 18, and the sinker-post stack's process bump takes 24. `generate.rs` `run_job_arms` merged cleanly, because #1131's refresh already holds both the sinker-burn early return and main's body-stack/neck lines. `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the stack's own files. Tests: `camcraft-post --test sinker_post` 6/6. App `sinker_burn` 10/10, `conformance` 7/7, `golden_cl` 25/25, `plasma_post_refusals` 7/7, `smoothing` 7/7. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` is clean: the stack carries the `Cutter::neck` test fix, so the app lib tests compile here. Stays draft.

Refreshed with main (9032da34) only (#1131's branch untouched): one conflict, .claude/PROCESS_VERSION (this branch 24, main 20) -> 25. No code conflicts; posted G-code goldens untouched. Head c4ddcc34. Tests: post sinker_post 6, app sinker_burn 10, conformance 7 - all pass; cargo test -p xtask 37/37; clippy -p app/post/ui/tools/motion/sim --all-targets -D warnings clean. Stays a draft.

Refreshed with main (c6597a76) and #1131 (ed6a1eb4): `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` renumbered (now 28, main is on 24); `solid_law_goldens.rs` kept main's `posted_gates` harness (#1096); `crates/tools/src/electrode.rs` takes `turning: None` for main's new `Tool` field. Head 1b230423.

The two guard failures:
- `recorded_streams::every_shipped_post_script_has_its_suite`: `sinker_post.rs` moves to `crates/post/tests/script_sinker_iso.rs` and adds `post_suite!("sinker-iso.cps")`. The nine recorded mill cases post machine-less, so each golden in `recorded/golden/sinker-iso/` is the post's named refusal ("serves sinker_edm machines only"). The sinker's own stream (the Sinker Burn CL golden, wrapped the way the dump wraps it) posts through the binary on the fixture dialect to `recorded/golden/sinker-iso/sinker_burn_cavity.nc`. That file is byte-identical to app's `nc/sinker-iso/sinker_burn_cavity.nc`. `recorded::verdict_on` / `compare` are split out of `verdict` / `check`. All goldens were written by the suite's own WRITE_GOLDEN path.
- `solid_law_goldens::every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes`: `sinker_burn_cavity.nc` is now judged, not put in UNJUDGED. `posted_gates::sinker_gouge_cells` generates the real Sinker Burn on a sinker over a block whose cavity is the electrode grown by the gap. It proves the program is the CL golden byte for byte, then runs `stock_sim::simulate_document`, the program verdict with the electrode's box atom: 0 gouge cells. I checked by hand that a 5 mm cavity gives 432 gouge cells, so the judge does catch an overburn. No law was loosened.

Tests: post `script_sinker_iso` 16/16, `recorded_streams` 10/10. App `solid_law_goldens` 5/5, `sinker_burn` 10/10, `conformance` 7/7. Clippy on post, app and tools with `-D warnings` is clean.
`coarse_laws`: `every_kind_is_either_judged_or_refused...` passes with #1131's fix. Four other `coarse_laws` tests fail, and the same failure is on main since #1074: the test expects "re-import with a larger budget" but `model_fidelity::TOO_COARSE` now says "larger STEP facet budget". This PR doesn't cause it.

**Still conflicting, so I stopped:** main's newest merge b7d3512e (#1116, op icons) moved `op_icon` out of `panes.rs` into `op_icons.rs`. It also retired the glyph-reuse law: every `OpType` must wear its own SVG-mastered `op-*` icon (`op_icon_table::every_op_kind_has_its_own_svg_mastered_icon`). The stack maps `OpType::SinkerBurn => Icon::Drill`, which main's law now rejects. A real fix needs a new original `op-sinker-burn` SVG master and its PNG. That belongs in #1131, which adds `SinkerBurn`, and #1131 and #1136 now show CONFLICTING too. Once #1131 has the glyph, this PR merges #1131 and then main.

PROCESS_VERSION renumbered to 31: main is on 25, open peers hold 26-30 (#972 28, #1033 29, #1124 30). Head 99bf379f. The version file is the only change. The PR still conflicts with main over the SinkerBurn glyph, as in my comment above.

Refreshed with main and #1131 (50e395e8): merged #1131's reworked EDM base, then upstream/main (6a10c5ad, clean). Head 34bb4413.

What changed:
- `edm.rs`: took #560's section (strict keys, `parse_edm` with the declared kind, conditions in `edm_conditions.rs`) and re-added `codes` on top: it is now one of `COMMON_KEYS` (either EDM kind; the wire post #533 reads its own roles), read after `conditions` and checked by `Edm::is_sane`. Any other unknown key still refuses by name.
- `machine/mod.rs`, `posting.rs`, `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`: kept both sides. `default_post_for(SinkerEdm)` is the sinker post; `WireEdm` stays Builtin (refused by `post_serves` and the engine's serves law).
- The serves law and `posting_family` are different doors, so both stay: `family_at_post` refuses an op whose family the machine cannot run, and `serves_gate` refuses a post dialect on a machine kind it does not declare. The base had no post-dialect refusal for EDM apart from the picker listing, so nothing was removed.
- The fixture `sinker-iso-dialect.mch` already passes the new condition bounds (id `S1`, gap 0.05, undersize 0.1 on a sinker). Unchanged.
- New pin `edm_codes::tests::codes_is_a_key_of_either_edm_kind_and_reads_after_the_strict_keys`. Decision note added to `docs/decisions/542-sinker-iso-post.md`.
- PROCESS_VERSION 31 (main is on 25).

Tests: post `script_sinker_iso` 10/10, `recorded_streams` 16/16, post lib 38/38; app `solid_law_goldens` 5, `sinker_burn` 10, `conformance` 7, `coarse_laws` 6, `plasma_post_refusals` 7, `smoothing` 7, `edm_machine` 5, `edm_conditions` 1, all green. `clippy -D warnings` is clean on post, app and tools (all targets). Still a draft.

Refreshed with #1131 5fc71cf2 (ab339b70): merged #1131's test-only commit; the one conflict (crates/app/tests/sinker_burn.rs) took #1131's tests/edm/sinker_fixture.rs module; #542's three post tests keep their calls via `use sinker_fixture::*`, and `sinker_doc_on` (a sinker document on a given machine text) moved into the fixture with `sinker_doc` delegating to it; DIALECT/SINKER_POST/post_burn stay local. posted_gates::sinker_gouge_cells uses no moved helper. upstream/main already contained; PROCESS_VERSION stays 31. Tests: sinker_burn 10/10 (7 from #1131 + 3 from #542), sinker_burn_held 6/6, stock_sim_held lib 2/2, solid_law_goldens 5/5, conformance 7/7, coarse_laws 6/6, post script_sinker_iso 16/16, recorded_streams 10/10, clippy -D warnings (app, post, all targets) clean.

This conflicts with main (now 62a2c93a). Two files: `crates/post/tests/recorded/mod.rs` - the harness changed on both sides (your branch passes `--machine` straight through; main now reads the case's machine, mirrors it with `machine::mirror` into a temp `.mch` and passes that) - same-logic, needs your judgement, likely folding your change into main's mirror block; and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (yours 31 vs main's 29 - 31 stands unless a sibling claim lands first). Please `git merge upstream/main`, resolve deliberately, and push.

Taken for the refresh (SKULL, mkinney fork agent): #1131 has merged, so SKULL is merging main into #1141, then #1165 onto the refreshed #1141, per the maintainer's ask. Other sessions: please leave this PR alone until SKULL's 'ready for review' comment.

Refresh stopped (SKULL, author side). Nothing was pushed; the head is still ab339b70. Merging main (0ad525d8) is a same-logic clash on the posted-G-code path, not a list merge. Since this PR was written, main landed the wire EDM post (#533) and its own serves law (#1232/#1266):
- **Code store:** both sides added `edm_codes::parse_codes`/`codes_sane`. Main keeps the codes on `Machine.edm_codes` with a stricter validator; this PR keeps them on `Edm.codes`.
- **`post/machine.rs` mirror and `script_props`:** both write `edm`, in different shapes, and the PR scales units while main passes the value through raw.
- **serves law:** this PR's engine `serves_gate` (a string, refuses a post that declares nothing) would refuse main's `wire-iso.cps`. Main uses a manifest `serves = [...]` read app-side in `posting_serves.rs`.
- **`recorded/mod.rs`:** main's harness mirrors through its own mirror, so the sinker-iso goldens depend on the mirror chosen.

**Plan (author decision, to be recorded in the decision file):** rework this branch onto main's designs:
- main's `Machine.edm_codes` and its validator;
- main's manifest `serves` plus `posting_serves.rs`, adding the sinker post to the registry, with the PR's engine `serves_gate` dropped;
- the sinker fields (orbits, pickup, conditions) mirrored beside main's `edm.codes`/`awt`;
- the sinker-iso goldens re-checked, with any output change explained.

That is a rework on effort:high, not a conflict refresh, and it changes posted output, so it comes back for a full review. #1165 (stacked) waits on it. The "taken" claim above stays for this rework.

Reworked onto main's EDM designs (author side, not a review) - ready for review.

Head 0751b16b: `git merge upstream/main` (0ad525d8, no rebase) as d64cd8c4, then three rework commits. Decisions are recorded in `docs/decisions/542-sinker-iso-post.md`, under "2026-11-12 - rework onto main's EDM designs".

**Decisions applied**
1. **Codes.** The branch now uses main's `Machine.edm_codes` and main's validator (`post::machine::edm_codes`). The PR's `Edm.codes`, `parse_codes` and `codes_sane` are gone. `SINKER_CODES` stays only as the list of names the sinker post reads, and a unit test checks that list against main's law. A sinker code main's validator refuses (a bracket, a capital name) is refused by name.
2. **serves.** The sinker post declares `serves = ["sinker_edm"];`. It is added to `BUILTINS`, `SINKER_POSTS`, `post_serves`, `default_post_for` and `post_offer`, with main's wire entries kept. The engine `serves_gate` is dropped (`machine_edm.rs` is removed). Main's "no post for a sinker EDM machine yet (#542)" door (`posting_family::edm_at_post`) is removed. Its only live arm was the sinker one, and every writer reaches `posting_serves::refusal` right after it, which refuses any post that does not serve a sinker, by name. `wire-iso.cps` still posts on a wire machine: main's `wire_post.rs` and `script_wire_iso.rs` are unchanged and green.
   - **One extra change, so that no safety check is lost:** main's engine refuses `PARAM EdmCondition` through any script without `wireEdm`. The PR's sinker stream used the same word, so the sinker post was refused its own burn. The sinker condition is now `PARAM SinkerCondition`, and the engine has a matching door: a script whose `serves` does not name `sinker_edm` is refused the sinker section by name. This keeps a mill post off a sinker burn at the CLI now that `serves_gate` is gone. Main's wire door is unchanged.
3. **Mirror.** `mirror()` writes main's `edm: {codes, awt}`. For a sinker it also writes `orbits`, `pickup` and `conditions` in the same object (mm, from the parser). The wire mirror is unchanged. `script_props` has one `edm` key (main's). No unit scaling is needed: the post reads only words and ids from `edm` (codes, orbit kinds, condition ids), never a length, so the PR's re-parse of the raw file is gone. No inch sinker machine test existed before, so none was carried over.
4. **Recorded harness.** The branch uses main's `recorded/mod.rs`, with `verdict_on` and `compare` added. The sinker burn case hands the binary the fixture dialect file as written: the binary mirrors a vendor tree itself, through the same `mirror` (#996). A pre-mirrored EDM `.mch` is not a file the reader takes back: the mirror puts `kind` at its top level, not under `general.kind`, so the `edm` section is refused ("only a wire_edm or sinker_edm machine states an edm section").
5. **Main's sinker features.**
   - Orbit (#544) and Side Burn (#545, tag 43) are **refused by name**. The post writes a straight burn only, and the orbit's explicit moves are what the stock sim judged, so swapping them for the control's orbit word would post motion the sim never judged. The PR's `orbitWord()` is removed.
   - A condition id that the machine's `edm.conditions` does not list (exact, as the table writes it) is **refused by name**.
   - The app now emits `SinkerCondition`, `ElectrodePickup` and, for an orbit, `EdmOrbit` / `EdmOrbitRadius`, for both sinker op kinds, so these refusals can fire.
   - Wear (#1157) is not merged (its PR is open), so it is not handled.
6. **Smaller conflicts.**
   - `PROCESS_VERSION` and `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` take main's. This drops the PR's sinker-post section and its `serves` manifest line there. The PR no longer changes a process file, so there is no bump.
   - `machine/mod.rs` and the `edm.rs` doc take main's.
   - `solid_law_goldens.rs` and `CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md` keep both sides; the stream row now names `SinkerCondition`.
   - PNGs, CHANGELOG and RECOMMENDED are untouched (main's).
   - `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`'s `edm.codes` paragraph now states main's validator.
7. Every refusal on both sides is kept. The EDM-door refusal that was removed is replaced by the serves door's refusal. It is still by name and still writes no file; only the text changes, to "... does not serve ..., a sinker EDM machine".

**Refusals added (each pinned)**
- `script_sinker_iso::an_orbit_is_refused_by_name_even_one_the_machine_lists`: "a circular orbit - CamCraft expands it into the moves the stock sim judged, and this post writes a straight burn down Z only ..."
- `script_sinker_iso::a_sinker_side_burn_is_refused_by_name`: "a Sinker Side Burn moves the electrode sideways - this post writes a straight burn down Z only"
- `script_sinker_iso::a_condition_the_machine_does_not_list_is_refused_by_name` (S2, the wrong case s1, and no table at all): "condition S2 is not in ...'s edm.conditions ..."
- Engine `SinkerCondition` door: `script_sinker_iso::a_mill_post_on_a_sinker_and_the_sinker_post_on_a_mill_are_refused` (fanuc, haas, tormach-plasma, fanuc-lathe and wire-iso on the sinker burn).
- `edm_codes::the_sinker_names_pass_the_one_law_and_a_bad_sinker_code_refuses_by_name`
- App stream: `sinker_burn::an_orbit_burn_and_a_side_burn_say_their_sinker_params_in_the_stream`

**Output changes, line by line**
- **Burn programs: byte-identical.** `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sinker-iso/sinker_burn_cavity.nc`, `sinker_burn_program.nc` and `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/sinker-iso/sinker_burn_cavity.nc` are unchanged.
- **Nine recorded mill cases** (`recorded/golden/sinker-iso/{arcs,drill_retract,empty_section,extreme_coords,full_circle,full_circle_raw,probe,rotary,tool_change}.refusal`):
  - Line 1 was `; ... the post stopped, nothing written` and is now `; ... N warning(s), the program is never released`. The engine `serves_gate` stop was dropped (decision 2), so the refusal is now the script's counted warnings, the form every other post's refusals take.
  - The line `post: this post serves sinker_edm machines only - <machine> is not declared one of them` is replaced by `warning: the generic sinker post writes sinker EDM blocks - <machine> is not declared a sinker EDM`. This is the script's own machine check, which already existed in the PR.
  - Added lines are the warnings the run now reaches past onOpen, all of them existing refusals:
    - `states N rpm - an electrode turns no spindle ...` (each case);
    - `a canned cycle - a sinker burn has none` (drill_retract);
    - the engine's probe-hook refusals (probe);
    - the engine's threadHands refusal (tool_change).
  - Every case is still refused and never released. The CLI now writes the (header-only) program file beside the refusal, as it does for every warning-refused post. The app's serves door refuses a sinker post on a non-sinker machine before any of this.
- **`css_then_live.refusal` and `live_then_stop.refusal` are new.** They are main's two recorded cases, which run on every post suite, recorded in the same form. Besides the warnings above, they carry the engine's own liveTooling and afterModes refusals.

**Gate on 0751b16b**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: every suite green (`script_sinker_iso` 20, `script_wire_iso` 11, `recorded_streams` 12, lib 41).
- 18 app binaries green: conformance, plasma_post, plasma_post_refusals, post_serves_kind, post_serves_plasma, posting, sinker_burn, sinker_burn_held, sinker_orbit, sinker_side, solid_law_goldens, wire_contour, wire_post, wire_readers, wire_verify, smoothing, edm_machine, mcp_edit_machine.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green - post suites (6 s) and app suites (1140 s), 19.1 min wall, 0 failed (log gate-logs/quick-20261113-033439).

**Not exercised**
- No real EDM control.
- No orbit or side-burn program posted end to end through `post_setup`: the fixture cavity fits a straight burn only, so the stock sim would convict either one first. The refusals are pinned on the post and on the app's stream.
- Wear (#1157) is not handled.
- `site/content/guide/machines.md` still says on main that no wire post ships. I fixed only the sinker sentence and the general "no EDM post" line.
- #1165 (stacked) was not started.

Back to draft (author side): upstream main moved to a9ec0982 while the gate ran (it merged #1157 wear, #1143, #1147) and the PR conflicts again in `crates/app/tests/wire_post.rs`. Merging main once more and checking the sinker post against #1157's layered wear burns; re-gated and re-flagged after.
